title: Claude moves new Pro and Max Cowork tasks to the cloud
friendlyTitle: New Claude Cowork tasks now run in the cloud
summary: From October 6, new Claude Cowork tasks on Pro and Max plans run on Anthropic’s servers, and the “Only on your computer” option is being removed. Existing local tasks remain local; connected desktop folders can still be reached only while the app is open, with individual files copied to the cloud when a task needs them.
friendlySummary: New Cowork tasks for Pro and Max users run on Anthropic’s computers instead of only on the user’s machine. This lets work continue in the background, but files may be copied to the cloud when needed.
whyItMatters: Cloud execution lets tasks continue when a laptop closes and makes sessions available across devices, but it changes the privacy and control model. People whose work must remain on one machine will need Claude Code desktop or another local workflow, and should review connected folders and retention settings.
friendlyWhyItMatters: The change is more convenient, but some people need work to stay on one computer. Check which folders Claude can use and choose a local tool for sensitive jobs.
